resources.string: Fɔli, ɲɛfɔli, cogoya ani lamɛnt kɛcogo
Foli, dosiye tɔgɔw ani telesarsecogo suganditaw telesarse
Barokun, kulɛriw, tabw ani layidu talenw
Tariku, ɲinini tariku ani kunnafoniw maralenw lajɛ
Baarakɛminɛnw, kanw, maraw ani kɔnɔkow filɛriw
Ladɔnniyali walew, lasɔminiw ani kunnafoni kura cikanw
App dataw bila ka taa jamana wɛrɛw la, ka don u kɔnɔ ani ka u lasegin
